meta.priceDisclaimer: Unit prices and setup charges are read from Business Edge's own listings and are real published break pricing, not guesses — but they are still not a quote. US-sourced goods carry exchange, brokerage and duty on top, and shipping is billed at actual cost. Confirm before committing budget.

1.label: Tier 1 · Walk-up
1.blurb: Hand to anyone who stops. Cheap enough that a few hundred units doesn't hurt, good enough that it isn't insulting.

2.label: Tier 2 · Real conversation
2.blurb: For someone who scanned, asked a question, or stood at the booth for more than a minute. The sweet spot for 'useful, not junk'.

3.label: Tier 3 · Qualified lead
3.blurb: Kept under the counter and handed over after a real conversation with someone who matters. Perceived value should read well above what you paid.

items.name: Quetico 10 oz cotton & jute fashion tote
items.supplierProductName: Quetico 10 oz Cotton & Jute Fashion Tote
items.whyItWorks: The one item on this list someone carries out of the venue in front of everyone else, and it costs less than half what the ripstop tote did. 40% recycled cotton, 40% rPET and 20% jute, so the sustainability line is the product rather than a claim printed on a card beside it. Jute gussets give it a base so it stands up on a table instead of slumping, and the cotton front and back are a flat surface for the logo. 9.25" W x 11.75" H x 4.5" D.
items.decoration: Full-colour transfer up to 64 square inches: $65.00 setup, then $1.45 a unit. A repeat order of the same artwork drops the setup to $30.00; an ink change is $35.00.
items.watchOut: Two colourways only — heathered grey/brown and natural/brown. The listing shows a $65.00 full-colour-transfer setup AND a separate "Setup Charge: $75.00" without saying which method the second belongs to, so confirm with Business Edge before you budget it. US-sourced, so exchange, brokerage and duty land on top, and the smallest break is 75 rather than 50.

items.name: Pop-up phone holder
items.whyItWorks: Sticks to the back of a phone and stays there for months, which is months of logo exposure rather than one afternoon. Doubles as a stand and a cord wrap. Full-colour digital print over a large area, so the mark reads properly.
items.decoration: Full-colour digital print across the whole button. White or black base.
items.watchOut: The price cliff is the whole story: $6.07 at 250 but $4.24 at 501. If the real number lands near 500, ordering the extra units costs almost nothing. Free shipping to one metro location.

items.name: B-Safe key touchless tool
items.whyItWorks: Brushed copper, keyring-sized, and genuinely on-theme for a life-sciences audience — copper's antimicrobial property is the product, not a claim on a sticker. Opens doors, presses buttons and taps screens.
items.decoration: Laser engraving is +$1.00 a unit plus $62.11 engraving setup, on top of the $100 die. Blank is an option if budget is tight.
items.watchOut: The $100 die is a one-off tooling charge, not a per-order setup — worth confirming whether a repeat order re-charges it. Minimum break starts at 250, so there is no small-run price.

items.name: Accent dye-sublimated mouse pad
items.supplierProductName: Accent Dye Sublimated Mouse Pad with Antimicrobial Additive
items.whyItWorks: Edge-to-edge dye sublimation means the whole surface is yours — a full design, not a logo in a corner. It then sits on a desk in the person's line of sight every working day.
items.decoration: Edge-to-edge dye sublimation, full colour. Per-imprint personalisation is +$1.40 a unit if each pad needs a different name.
items.watchOut: The flattest price curve of the four — going from 300 to 1,000 units only saves about 50 cents each, so there is little reason to over-order. 9" × 7.5", so it ships as a box, not an envelope.
